description.value: Guildford Sushi House is a Japanese and Asian restaurant tucked into a Surrey strip mall, serving sushi, sashimi, specialty rolls, and traditional appetizers with dine-in, takeout, and delivery options. The kitchen emphasizes consistency in its Japanese staples, and the menu spans everything from miso soup and edamame to nigiri sets and house special combos. Online ordering for pickup and delivery is available, making it a practical stop for cyclists passing through the Guildford area.
